messages:
incident-bot: Paging: elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed from ap-south egress to partner-auth (third-party). Error spike started ~2058887200. P50 latency -> 600ms, 5xx rate -> 12%. oncall: @roberto-oncall will handle. :rotating_light:
roberto-oncall: Ack. I'm oncall — taking lead. Can folks drop quick signal on customer impact?
sarah-plat: Seeing a steady bump in client-facing 502/504s for sessions routed through ap-south edge. Top affected routes: /v1/generate and /v1/stream. Impacted customers: 3 large tenants with traffic routed to ap-south, some errors correlate with auth calls to partner-auth (timeout ~2.1s).
devon-sre: Pulling logs now. I see repeated egress timeouts to partner-auth IPs (10.23.45.67:443) with TCP retransmits + TLS handshake timeouts. Gateway upstreams show circuit-breaker tripping briefly then recovering.
mike-runtime: Could be an upstream degradation causing our gateway to queue requests and hit downstream timeouts. Suggest immediate mitigation: 1) enable gateway short-circuit fallback (route to auth-lite) 2) shift a portion of ap-south traffic to eu-west via smart-routing policy.
roberto-oncall: Agree. Plan: A) flip partial routing policy (20%) to eu-west B) enable auth-lite fallback C) increase gateway replica count by 2 in ap-south to reduce queuing. Doing canary 20% now.
roberto-oncall: Running command to patch routing policy (prod cluster):
```bash
kubectl -n redwood patch cm smart-routing --type json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/policies/ap-south/weight","value":80},{"op":"add","path":"/policies/ap-south/fallback","value":"eu-west"}]'
```
devon-sre: Confirmed policy change applied. Controller reports new weights: ap-south 80%, eu-west 20%. Traffic shift live.
sarah-plat: Customer-facing 502s down from 12% -> 6% in last 3 mins for the selected tenants. Overall P95 latency still elevated (~1.2s) on remaining ap-south traffic.
mike-runtime: Kicking off scale on gateway:
```bash
kubectl -n infra scale deployment/gateway-ap-south --replicas=6
```
roberto-oncall: Scaling accepted by cluster autoscaler; replicas moving from 4 -> 6.
devon-sre: Also toggled gateway short-circuit: auth calls will fallback to internal auth-lite for 30% of auth requests. Config applied via feature flag.
anya-cs: Notifying affected customers in the APAC cohort — posting to status page draft now. @kendra-bizops can you review the message before publish?
kendra-bizops: Reviewing now. Draft: "We're investigating intermittent errors in AP-South affecting authentication calls. We've shifted traffic and applied mitigations; some may still see increased latency. We will update in 15 minutes or earlier." OK to publish once we confirm drop below 3% 5xx.
sarah-plat: Metrics update: 5xx at 3.2% globally for the region, for the affected routes it's ~4.5%. Partner-auth upstream shows error rate still ~8% and elevated latency.
devon-sre: Diving into network path — traceroute to 10.23.45.67 shows intermittent packet loss at egress node 10.23.40.1. Opening a ticket with cloud provider for line-level.
roberto-oncall: If upstream remains flaky, we should consider expanding eu-west weight to 40% and enabling longer auth-lite fallbacks. Approving if metrics don't improve in next 8 minutes.
mike-runtime: Also enabling KV/PREFIX cache for repeated auth lookups to reduce egress load: toggled cache-for-auth TTL=30s for high-volume keys.
sarah-plat: After cache + routing shift + scale, customer-visible errors dropped to ~1.8% for the targeted tenants. Latency P95 down to ~750ms.
devon-sre: Cloud provider responded: "We're observing transient fabric issues impacting some egress nodes in ap-south; engineers applying micro-patches. Expected stabilization in ~20-30 minutes."
roberto-oncall: Good. We'll keep reroute active and start gradual rollback once provider confirms stability. Next steps: 1) Keep eu-west at 20% for 10 more mins, then reevaluate. 2) Keep auth-lite fallback enabled for 30 more mins. 3) Keep cache TTL=30s for now. 4) Prepare rollback playbook snippet in case eu-west has any quota issues.
anya-cs: Posted status update. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2058887777 (draft published).
kendra-bizops: Sent update to sales ops for priority customers.
mike-runtime: One gotcha: some customers have IP allowlists anchored to ap-south egress — watch for auth failures after routing change. Devon, can you list customers with strict allowlists?
devon-sre: Pulling allowlist table now — found 2 customers with strict allowlists. Notifying those teams to expect possible rejects; we'll provide temporary IPs from eu-west.
roberto-oncall: Logging action items in incident doc and handing to afternoon oncall in 30 mins. If errors stay <2% after 20 mins, we'll begin scaling down gateway from 6->4 and shift eu-west back to 10%.
sarah-plat: Marking this as partial regional outage affecting egress. No SLA breach yet but customer impact noted.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status -> mitigated (partial), severity -> SEV2, runbook -> https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/egress-partial-outage, pager -> paged.
roberto-oncall: Thanks team — keep threads for 15-min cadence. I'll handoff to @devon-sre at 2058887800 for steady-state monitoring and rollback coordination.
devon-sre: Ack, I'll monitor dashboards and coordinate rollback if cloud provider clears.
anya-cs: I'll follow up on customer comms as we confirm full recovery.
roberto-oncall: Closing my active lead. Handoff complete.
